panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (a, b). a: Coronal CT panel from a case report titled 'Silent Sinus Syndrome of the Frontal Sinus' showing reduced left frontal sinus volume, retraction of the inter-frontal sinus septum, upward displacement of the left frontal sinus floor, and frontal bone hyperostosis, consistent with frontal silent sinus syndrome. b: Axial CT panel from the same case report showing the left frontal sinus changes of silent sinus syndrome, including reduced volume and septal retraction with frontal bone hyperostosis.

The quadrilateral cartilage was deviated to the right inferiorly, and the superior bony septum was significantly deviated to the left, narrowing the frontal sinus ostium.
